# miniz

Version: 3.1.2
Upstream: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/3.1.2
License: see LICENSE (unmodified upstream copy).

The upstream .c/.h files are vendored without modifications. miniz_export.h is
the local static-library export definition normally generated by upstream CMake.
The sources are compiled as C++ (supported by miniz) alongside the viewer.
ZIP reading is used by EpubBook; ZIP writing is used only by regression fixtures.
